formats.words.txt: canonical<TAB>count per line; # lines are comments; counts are relative, log-normalized at load
formats.common.txt: top common words by frequency, LC_ALL=C sorted
formats.dictionary.txt: one lowercase ASCII word per line, LC_ALL=C sorted; validity lexicon for autocorrect only
